{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check which patient_ids are duplicated
duplicate_patients = df[df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id'], keep=False)]['patient_id'].unique()
print("List of duplicate patient_ids:", duplicate_patients)

# Check sample_seq for duplicates
sample_seq_stats = df[df['patient_id'].isin(duplicate_patients)].groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
print("Max sample_seq for duplicate patients:", sample_seq_stats['sample_seq'].max())

# Confirm that the highest sample_seq is unique per patient
max_sample_seq_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
print("Number of patients with max sample_seq = 2:", (max_sample_seq_per_patient['sample_seq'] == 2).sum())"}
